narrative.overview: WebScope uses a graphite working surface for sustained technical investigation. The visual hierarchy follows the analyst's task: establish context, inspect observations, then record a judgment. It is deliberately a workstation rather than a marketing dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent assessment context and compact navigation.
Evidence and provenance close to the observation they support.
Separate presentation of automated facts and analyst decisions.
Dense tables with local scrolling, not page-wide overflow.

rules.name: The Separate Signals Rule
rules.body: Severity color must not imply confidence or an analyst-confirmed issue.

rules.name: The Technical Values Rule
rules.body: Monospace identifies a value to inspect or copy, never merely a security-themed aesthetic.

dos: Do keep source evidence reachable from observations and decisions.
Do separate severity, confidence, review status, and priority.
Do use the shared control, table, field, and status components.
Do preserve readable columns with local table scrolling on mobile.
Do describe empty, loading, failed, and truncated states explicitly.
donts: Don't invent assessment data, counters, intelligence, or results.
Don't use severity color as a substitute for an analyst conclusion.
Don't render target content as executable HTML.
Don't turn ordinary sections into decorative cards or glowing panels.
Don't hide collection authorization behind an automatic interaction.
